result.summary: The page looks well-structured overall. Two notable findings: the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant (Green Bowl Poké) duplicated in two consecutive cards, and the green promo banner's decorative circles create slightly uneven visual balance. No critical layout breaks detected.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Green Bowl Poké' twice in a row with identical artwork, delivery time (15–25 min), and fee (€0.90), which looks like a data duplication error
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list so the same venue doesn't appear twice in the same carousel row

issues.description: The promo banner's right side appears visually empty compared to the dense left side, making the layout feel slightly unbalanced
issues.suggestion: Optionally adjust decorative elements or add a right-side icon/CTA so the banner feels more balanced
